CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. Which response best shows understanding of Samson kills a Lion? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Samson kills a Lion.
   B. Apply the teaching of Samson kills a Lion with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Samson kills a Lion has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Samson kills a Lion to insult classmates of other faiths.
